data.raw_text:
Welcome to Manila, GumberBear international Fans! 🇵🇭✨

If you’re flying in for the LenaMiu Fan Meet at UP Theater, here’s a quick guide to help you get there safely and smoothly:

✈️ From Ninoy Aquino International Airport (NAIA):

The most convenient option is booking a ride via Grab. It’s safer, fixed-rate, and easier, especially if it’s your first time in Manila. Just input “UP Theater” as your destination.

🚗 Travel time: around 1 to 1.5 hours depending on traffic (Manila traffic is real 😅).

🚍 Public transport:
It’s cheaper, but can be confusing (multiple transfers like jeepneys, MRT, buses). If you’re not familiar with the system, Grab is highly recommended.

⚠️ Friendly reminders:
• Stay vigilant with your belongings at all times
• Avoid unofficial taxis or random offers outside the airport
• Some may overcharge foreigners, always check prices first
• Keep your phone charged for navigation & booking rides

If your hotel is already around Quezon City / near UP Theater, just book a 𝐆𝐫𝐚𝐛 ride for the easiest and safest trip to the venue. It’s convenient, fixed-price, and less hassle, especially for international fans. 💖

📍 From nearby hotels, travel time is usually around 10–20 minutes depending on traffic.

Stay safe, plan ahead, and see you all at UP Theater! 🇵🇭✨

#LenaMiu #ลีน่าหมิว
#MiuNatsha #หมิวณัชชา
#lalinalena #ลีน่าลลินา
